name: 53039 · Juneau, WI
findings: ZIP 53039 (Juneau) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53039 (Juneau) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53039 (Juneau) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).
